instruction: Show how to locate the process number for LibreOffice Writer via the Ubuntu command line.

command: output=$(ps aux | grep "[s]office"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "pid not found"; else echo "pid found"; fi; output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep -E "[p]idof|pgrep|ps"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "not searched from terminal"; else echo "searched from terminal"; fi
